release_notes:
## [1.3.1](https://github.com/MrCool-888/mrcool-patches/compare/v1.3.0...v1.3.1) (2026-11-04)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* support OpenBubbles build 20002293 ([2499479](https://github.com/MrCool-888/mrcool-patches/commit/2499479cb39d4b88e86e87831e85fe82c6b77f52))

## OpenBubbles compatibility

The OpenBubbles patches require **2.0.0, build 20002293, ARM64**. The version name alone does not identify the required build. The supplied single phone APK uses the existing OpenBubbles Wear signing key and updates the prior patched universal APK in place. Preserve the existing installation and app data; a stock installation uses a different signing key.

The update passed patch, integration, native linkage, Android runtime, signature, alignment, and in-place upgrade checks. The user confirmed it is working after updating the validation relay. The watch application is unchanged.

## Original OpenBubbles input for Morphe

Download [the original ARM64 split archive](https://github.com/MrCool-888/mrcool-patches/releases/download/v1.3.1/OpenBubbles-2.0.0-20002293-original-arm64.apks), then select it in Morphe as an existing APK file. It contains the original base, ARM64, English, and xxhdpi splits from OpenBubbles 2.0.0 (version code 20002293). Morphe merges the splits while patching. Its download flow does not currently support a custom APK URL supplied by a patch bundle, so select this file manually.



SHA-256: archive `b48adb5fd1ad9d29ac00ab429efb388244c1270671e690c1f3d29c5076454280`. Morphe must sign the patched output with the existing installation's key to update it in place.

## Installing updates without losing data

Android requires the installed app and its update to be signed with the same key. The pre-patched phone APK is signed with the OpenBubbles Wear release key and can update an existing APK signed with that key. Morphe signs its output with the key configured in Morphe; its output and the pre-patched APK can update one another only when that configured key matches the existing installation. A default Morphe key, another person's key, and the stock Play Store key cannot update an installation signed with a different key. Do not uninstall or clear app data to work around a signature mismatch as you will most likely be rate limited again.
